resources.string: Connect the car and iPhone to the same external Wi-Fi in system settings. Enter its exact name and WPA2 password below; leave the password empty only for an open network. Use WPA2 or WPA2/WPA3 mixed mode and disable client isolation on the router. Zeekr CarPlay keeps this Wi-Fi connection and creates no hotspot.

Use the car’s hotspot for the smoothest wireless CarPlay. You do not need to join it manually on your iPhone; Zeekr CarPlay sends the hotspot details over Bluetooth. Select 5 GHz in car settings if available.
Zeekr CarPlay Usage Access
CarPlay authentication could not be loaded. Install the complete Zeekr CarPlay build over this app. No uninstall or hotspot change is needed.
Zeekr CarPlay connects through the car hotspot “%1$s”. Turn it on in the car settings, then connect.
About Zeekr CarPlay
Allow Nearby devices for Zeekr CarPlay in the head unit’s app permissions.
Allow Nearby devices so Zeekr CarPlay can connect to your paired iPhone.
Allow precise Location for Zeekr CarPlay in the head unit’s app permissions.
Back to Zeekr CarPlay
Choose where to save your report. If the file picker is unavailable, Zeekr CarPlay saves it in the app.\u0020
Connect when Zeekr CarPlay opens
After the car wakes, open Zeekr CarPlay and start wireless CarPlay when the selected iPhone connects over Bluetooth. Some head units restrict background launches.
Could not start CarPlay. Return to Zeekr CarPlay and check app permissions.
Zeekr CarPlay
Hide the selected system bar in Zeekr CarPlay and CarPlay.
In CarPlay, swipe down with three fingers to open Zeekr CarPlay settings.
Make Zeekr CarPlay feel right for your car.
On your iPhone, open Settings → Bluetooth and pair with the car. Then return to Zeekr CarPlay and choose Connect phone.

Some firmwares block third-party boot receivers. This asks the head unit, over its own ADB link, to exempt Zeekr CarPlay from background limits so the boot broadcast can reach it. One-time; re-run after a firmware update.
Reports save to Downloads/DiPlay.\u0020

Return from car settings to Zeekr CarPlay, then connect. Accept the CarPlay prompt on your iPhone. A car internet plan is not required; mobile data availability depends on your phone’s network settings.

1. Open car hotspot settings, turn the hotspot on and select 5 GHz if available.\n2. Copy its name and password below exactly.\n3. Leave the car hotspot on when connecting. Zeekr CarPlay sends the details over Bluetooth; your iPhone joins automatically.
Zeekr CarPlay is starting CarPlay with your iPhone.
Hide the status and navigation bars in Zeekr CarPlay and CarPlay.
Usage Access lets Zeekr CarPlay follow the instrument theme and map card. Only BYD cluster activity events are processed locally. This car does not provide a working permission settings page.
This head unit cannot open VPN authorization, and Zeekr CarPlay cannot use its ADB over network to allow the VPN itself.
This head unit cannot open VPN authorization, and its ADB has not approved Zeekr CarPlay, so Zeekr CarPlay cannot allow the VPN itself.
This head unit cannot open VPN authorization. Return to Zeekr CarPlay to check connection permissions or use wireless.
Zeekr CarPlay · waiting for the CarPlay map

Zeekr CarPlay draws this card on the map. Move it in 2 % steps. The iOS glass card cannot be moved on its own. Changes apply without reconnecting. The custom card stays on for straight-ahead as well as turns.

Zeekr CarPlay reads the navi mode you pick on the steering wheel. In Off and Turn on by navi the dashboard shows arrows only, so the iPhone does not send the map; in Small and Full screen navi it does, within a second or two of the switch. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.
Checking ADB access… If the car asks, allow Zeekr CarPlay and tick “Always allow”.
Zeekr CarPlay is not approved yet. Tap Check ADB access, then allow Zeekr CarPlay on the car screen.
This head unit offers only wireless debugging with pairing, which Zeekr CarPlay does not support yet.

Zeekr CarPlay tells the iPhone the car\'s charge and range, so Apple Maps can warn about a low charge and suggest chargers on the way. The iPhone is told about an electric car only while Zeekr CarPlay can read the battery. Reconnects CarPlay. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.
Request Zeekr CarPlay ADB authorization
ADB is enabled, but this Zeekr CarPlay test app is not authorized yet.
The car allowed Zeekr CarPlay only once. Tap again and tick “Always allow” so background vehicle data can reconnect.

With Report location to iPhone on, Zeekr CarPlay also sends the car\'s wheel speed and gear, so Apple Maps can keep your position moving in tunnels and car parks. Reconnects CarPlay. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.

The card stays hidden until the car’s media stack has been opened. Opening the gate does that, which briefly brings the media screen to the front and then returns to Zeekr CarPlay. Leave it off to skip the screen flash. Applies at once.

While Zeekr CarPlay is in the background, the dashboard map also shows as a card on the home screen: BYD home, map home or your default launcher. Tap the card to open CarPlay, drag it to move it, and pinch it to resize it. The dashboard keeps its map. Needs permission to draw over other apps.

Launchers that support Zeekr CarPlay can show the live dashboard map inside their own home screen. Off by default, because any app on the head unit could then ask for the map. See docs/LAUNCHER_INTEGRATION.md.

Starts the saved car hotspot when Zeekr CarPlay opens. Turning this on automatically requests the required permissions through ADB; allow the prompt on the car screen. Enable “Open after the car starts” for boot startup. Keeps the hotspot name and password and never turns it off.

Nothing to type: the car hotspot settings are imported; when the car has none, Zeekr CarPlay writes its own details there after your confirmation, and devices using this hotspot may have to reconnect. Needs ADB on Android 11 and newer; not available on Android 8 to 10.
The car hotspot now uses the Zeekr CarPlay password.

The car\'s saved hotspot configuration could not be read. Continuing overwrites it with the Zeekr CarPlay hotspot details: the hotspot name may change, the password is replaced, and other connected devices have to re-enter the password.
Nothing could be read from the car and Zeekr CarPlay has no hotspot details yet. Continuing creates a new hotspot name and password in the car; other devices have to enter the new password.
Zeekr CarPlay\'s hotspot password is written to the car\'s hotspot settings. Devices using this hotspot may have to re-enter the password.
Zeekr CarPlay could not write the car hotspot settings. The name and password stay unchanged.
An open hotspot in Zeekr CarPlay does not overwrite the car\'s password.
Your report was saved privately in Zeekr CarPlay because a public save location was unavailable. Share it or view it here. Nothing is sent automatically.

BYD\'s custom key switches the volume keys between volume and dashboard map zoom while the dashboard shows the CarPlay map. A call always keeps the volume. On some cars the console volume sends the same keys, so it zooms too while zoom is on. Uses Zeekr CarPlay\'s wheel key service; the note on the dashboard needs ADB.

How much charging current Zeekr CarPlay offers the iPhone over USB. If wired CarPlay drops every few seconds and the iPhone reconnects by itself, the car\'s USB port may not supply enough power: try Reduced, then Low. The iPhone then charges more slowly. Applies at the next USB connection.

A single press keeps the car\'s action. Press twice within the selected interval; Zeekr CarPlay opens Siri after the selected delay. The wheel key service is required if the car\'s assistant takes over the screen. Applies immediately.
Only a long press of the wheel\'s voice button opens Siri. A short press does nothing in Zeekr CarPlay.
Zeekr CarPlay wheel keys

Optional: keep the stock map off the cluster while Zeekr CarPlay projects there. Off leaves it alone. Component mode hides its cluster projection; package mode disables the whole stock map until projection stops. Requires authorized local ADB. Changes apply after reconnecting.

When the head unit shows Zeekr CarPlay in split screen, CarPlay redraws for that window instead of shrinking with black bars, and back to full screen without reconnecting. The window\'s size is learned the first time, so the picture fits exactly from the next connection. With the dock on Automatic, CarPlay then puts it at the bottom. Applies at the next connection.

CarPlay can move to two thirds of the screen while Zeekr CarPlay shows a panel in the rest: on the passenger\'s side of a landscape screen, at the bottom of a portrait one (clock and, where it is read, the battery). Show and hide it from the in-session menu. Applies at the next connection.

Zeekr CarPlay offers the iPhone no CarPlay audio, so music, navigation and calls should go over the iPhone\'s Bluetooth connection with the car. Keep the iPhone paired with the car and choose Bluetooth as the car\'s audio source. If the sound plays on the iPhone instead, turn this off. Reconnects CarPlay.

Holds a Telecom call during CarPlay calls so the car switches to its phone audio state and its own echo cancellation works. Zeekr CarPlay’s echo canceller stays out of those calls. Your voice can come out louder or distorted. Off by default; applies at the next call.

Does the same while another app, such as WhatsApp, Telegram or Zoom, is in a voice or video call. Voice notes and plain recordings are left alone because the car mutes the plain microphone in this state. Needs Zeekr CarPlay running, so this also turns on the wheel-key accessibility service. Off by default.

Sends the CarPlay picture straight to the head unit\'s compositor instead of drawing it inside the Zeekr CarPlay window. Can lower the delay by about one screen refresh. Picture adjustments do not apply. Reconnects CarPlay.
No music for 15 seconds: the lamps go back to the car’s own settings, and Zeekr CarPlay takes over again when music starts.

While CarPlay music plays, the car\'s own ambient-light music rhythm runs, with the colours and effects set in the car\'s ambient-light menu, where its music rhythm must be on. Zeekr CarPlay does not set the lamps itself meanwhile. Checked when switched on. Needs the car\'s network ADB only where the head unit does not let Zeekr CarPlay start the rhythm itself.
The car\'s music rhythm is not available: Zeekr CarPlay cannot start it itself, and Zeekr CarPlay\'s network ADB access or the head unit\'s audio service call is missing. Nothing was saved.
Size of text and controls on Zeekr CarPlay\'s own screens. Automatic enlarges them on large screens with a low density. CarPlay is not affected.
Show a QR code so a phone browser on the same network can export or import Zeekr CarPlay settings. The service stops when you leave the page.
This file is not a Zeekr CarPlay settings backup.
Once a day, Zeekr CarPlay checks GitHub for a new version and shows it on the home screen. It never downloads without your tap.
Zeekr CarPlay couldn’t read the DiLink version. Choose it below, or keep Not sure.

Stops Zeekr CarPlay from requesting media audio focus while CarPlay music is active. Enable this if your head unit routes its physical volume buttons to Zeekr CarPlay and they no longer adjust volume. Steering-wheel play, pause and track controls may stop working on head units that require focus. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.

During each CarPlay navigation prompt, Zeekr CarPlay requests temporary audio focus that lets other sound duck, and releases it after the prompt. Try this if prompts are silent until music plays, or if music should get quieter during prompts. The head unit’s own audio may get quieter or pause during prompts. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.

For launchers that show Zeekr CarPlay in a card or picture-in-picture window, such as BYD\'s DiYou desktop. CarPlay opens in Zeekr CarPlay\'s own window, as in 0.2.11 and earlier, instead of a separate full-screen one. Applies the next time CarPlay opens, without disconnecting.
The iPhone chosen in Zeekr CarPlay is no longer paired with the car
Pair the iPhone with the car\'s Bluetooth again, or return to Zeekr CarPlay and tap Choose iPhone to pick another one. Then retry.
Several devices are paired with the car. Return to Zeekr CarPlay, tap Choose iPhone and pick yours, then retry.
The car hotspot settings differ from those saved in Zeekr CarPlay
The hotspot interface saved in Zeekr CarPlay does not exist on this car
Check that the car hotspot is on and its name and password match Zeekr CarPlay settings. If available, use 5 GHz, then retry.
Allow the requested USB, Nearby devices or Location permissions for Zeekr CarPlay on the head unit, then retry.
Retry the connection. If it fails again, return to Zeekr CarPlay and save a report under Settings → Diagnostics.
Make sure the head unit and the iPhone are on the same Wi-Fi network and its name and password match Zeekr CarPlay settings, then retry.

Turns on the saved car hotspot when Zeekr CarPlay opens and before a wireless connection. Zeekr CarPlay needs Android\'s “Modify system settings” access; ADB is not required. To have the hotspot after a full restart, also turn on opening Zeekr CarPlay after the car starts. The hotspot is not turned off automatically.
“Modify system settings” access is not allowed yet. Allow it so Zeekr CarPlay can turn on the hotspot.

Over Wi-Fi Direct the car searches for Wi-Fi networks every few seconds, and each search makes music and video stutter. With this on, Zeekr CarPlay pauses the search while CarPlay runs. The car then also does not join a known network, such as your phone\'s hotspot, by itself until CarPlay ends; you can still join one in the car\'s Wi-Fi settings. Turn it off to let the car join automatically. Applies at the next connection.

Optional: swipe up with the configured settings gesture fingers to show hidden car status/navigation bars for five seconds; swipe down still opens Zeekr CarPlay settings. Disable on head units with conflicting gestures. Some firmware may ignore the request.

Assign any available steering-wheel or keyboard key to toggle CarPlay music playback. Works while CarPlay runs, including in the background if the wheel-key service is enabled. During calls or when disconnected, the vehicle keeps the key. A key reserved by firmware may not reach Zeekr CarPlay.

Shows the Zeekr CarPlay icon as a bubble over the head unit\'s home screen: tap it to come back to CarPlay and drag it anywhere. It hides as soon as a Zeekr CarPlay screen is open and comes back when you leave. Hold it to lock its place, hold it again to unlock. Needs \"display over other apps\".

Half screen keeps the speed and status readouts the cluster normally shows beside the map; full screen lets the map fill the cluster. Zeekr CarPlay sets the shape whenever the CarPlay map appears, which otherwise overrides the shape picked on the car. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.
The tested information is already present. No duplicate added; Zeekr CarPlay has no rollback ownership of an existing element.
Hotspot must be confirmed off. Disconnect clients and turn it off in car settings, then retry. Zeekr CarPlay will not restart it automatically.
Choose a language for Zeekr CarPlay
Use the default connection mode and selected iPhone when Zeekr CarPlay opens. Manual connection buttons use the mode you choose.
